correctness.rationale: The identity D^q(-I+D^{-q}AD^q)D^{-q}=A-I proves spectrum independent of exponent q. A connected unique-hub graph has Perron root sqrt(Delta)<=rho(A)<Delta: Rayleigh vector with hub entry sqrt(Delta) and 1 on every neighbor gives the lower bound even with extra adjacent neighbors, and irreducible strict row-sum bound gives upper bound. Radius R_h(q)=sum_(j~h)(d_j/Delta)^q falls continuously and strictly from Delta at q=0 to 0 for q->infty because all neighbors have smaller degree. It crosses rho(A) and 1 uniquely in the stated order. Disc containment of rho-1 and stable-halfplane threshold follow directly. For star K_(1,n), R=n^(1-q), thresholds (1/2,1), and rho=sqrt(n). Exact analytic reasoning covers all admissible finite graphs; verifier star examples only corroborate.
